## Plan

- `hh-ontology`: register the five resource dims `env.cpu_ms` (counter),
  `env.memory_bytes`/`env.disk_bytes`/`env.pids`/`env.open_files` (gauges)
  in the §8.2 registered-ext set so the full `ResourceLimits` member set
  maps (ADR: dimension-set growth).
- `hh-env`: `resource_limits_to_budget_spec` (all 8 members → hard
  ceilings); `provision` allocates the env's `BudgetNode` under the run
  root when limits are declared (`budget_node_refs`); driver write-back of
  an amended policy (`apply_containment_amendment`); `rebind_credentials_
  for_fork` takes the parent `&EnvHandle` (inter-run).
- `hh-env::egress`: split `endorse_asked` → `endorse_gate` (gate-stage
  endorse returning `GateOutcome`) + the whole-pipeline `endorse_asked`
  retained; `GateAllow` carries `decided_by` + the effective `policy`.
- `hh-env::dispatch`: resume leg — a `net_egress` effect left `intended`
  by an egress ask looks up its `security.permission.pending` and the
  answering `security.permission.decided`; allow → `endorse_gate` → the
  carried `GateAllow` forwards post-`committed`; deny → `decided{deny,
  monitor}` + `refused`; unanswered → re-suspend on the same
  `permission_id` (no duplicate pending).
- `hh-embed`: session credential-broker custody (`EmbedService.
  credential_broker`, fail-closed `DenyAllResolver` default +
  `set_credential_broker`); `fork{env: snapshot}` calls the rebind seam
  after `derive_from_snapshot`.
- `hh-results`: `annotations_from_ledger.containment_amended` lifts a
  `security.containment.amended` row's presence onto the row.

## Test matrix

- hh-env egress battery: resume-endorsed `allow_once` forwards with
  `decided{allow, monitor}` and no duplicate pending; `deny` refuses;
  `allow_lease` lands the `amended` row, swaps the effective policy, writes
  the amended policy back to the env handle so a *fresh* dispatch allows
  without re-asking; unanswered resume re-suspends on the same
  `permission_id`.
- hh-env: `resource_limits_to_budget_spec` maps all 8 members; the spec
  validates; `Account::allocate` accepts it under a run root; provision
  fills `budget_node_refs` when limits are declared.
- hh-results: a subject run carrying `security.containment.amended`
  projects `annotations_from_ledger.containment_amended = true`.
- hh-embed: `fork{env: snapshot}` rebinds credentials — child
  `credential_bindings` minted, `security.credential.bound` rows on the
  child run, parent spellings resolve to nothing in the child broker view.
- Regression: existing egress/acceptance batteries stay green.

## Progress

- Seeded ledger; split decision: R2.9a lands DF-S1.12-1/-2 + DF-S2.4-1;
  R2.9b carries DF-S1.12-4/-6 + DF-S2.4-3 (manifest `## Plan extensions`).
- `hh-ontology`: `hh.env.{cpu_ms,memory_bytes,disk_bytes,pids,open_files}`
  registered (`DimensionId::ExtEnv*`); parse/round-trip tests updated —
  ADR-0340 D1 (env-capacity dims are admission guards, not traffic meters).
- `hh-env`: `resource_budget_spec` maps all eight `ResourceLimits` members
  to hard caps; `EnvDriver::allocate_resource_budget` allocates a pool
  child under the run's durable root (the `control.budget.allocated` row
  with no `parent` — never `manifest.budget`, a spec reference; ADR-0340
  D2); wired at `provision`, `provision_hosted`, and `spawn_handle`
  (fork/replace children allocate their own node — CC9 per handle).
  `EnvError::BudgetRefused` added (typed, never an unbudgeted bound set).
- `hh-env::egress`: `GateAllow` gains `decided_by` (`policy` on the direct
  gate, `monitor` on endorsement) + `amended_policy`; `endorse_gate` is the
  gate-stage half (`deny`/`more_info` → `decided{deny, monitor}` terminal;
  `allow_once` request-only; `allow_lease` → `amend(AddEgressAllow)` +
  `security.containment.amended` durable *before* the wire + cache insert +
  `GateAllow` carrying the amended policy); `endorse_asked` retained as the
  whole-pipeline composition (`endorse_gate` + `forward`).
- `hh-env::dispatch`: the resume leg — `egress_ask_state` folds the
  durable prefix for the effect's `net_egress` pending; unanswered ⇒
  re-suspend behind the same `permission_decided` wakeup (nothing minted);
  a final `decided{allow|deny}` on the pending's `permission_id` ⇒
  `endorse_gate` where `gate` would run; `allow_lease`'s amended policy
  writes back via `driver.apply_amended_containment` (+ the in-flight
  `handle` clone) so the next `decide_egress` sees the new `version_id`.
  `authorize` skips re-minting an identical recorded final verdict
  (`already_recorded` — the egress ask suspended *after* `decided{allow}`
  landed; restating it is a no-op, I-H7; a contradicting verdict still
  appends and fails honestly).
- `hh-embed`: `EmbedService.credential_broker` (kernel-held,
  `DenyAllResolver` default — fail-closed; `set_credential_resolver` for a
  composed host); `work.rs::fork{env: snapshot}` and
  `envops::env.derive{fork_snapshot}` both call
  `rebind_credentials_for_fork` (ADR-0340 D5 — parent *record* parameter,
  never a driver-table lookup, so cross-run forks work); the respond
  `security.permission.decided` for a `net_egress`-capability pending omits
  `effect_id` — the endorsement never claims the monitor's `(effect_id,
  attempt)` gate slot (ADR-0340 D6, I-H7 — `DuplicateDecision` would refuse
  the append).
- `hh-results`: `security.containment.amended` folds into
  `annotations_from_ledger.containment_amended[]` ({seq, from/to
  version_id, basis, scope, effect_id} — J3's floor; ADR-0340 D7).
